lessons.content:
PAGE_1:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 1 Get More Clients – Checklist  Introduction ü Running a small service business is a balancing act ü Finding new clients can be a constant struggle ü This course is aimed at: o Small service business owners or freelancers o Business coaches, consultants and advisors o Business service providers o Freelance creative such as web designers, illustrators, writers, or other artists o Professional service providers o Anyone who relies on getting individual clients  But I'm up to My Ears in Work Already… ü You should be continually looking for new business, even when you’re busy for a number of reasons o Your dream client can come at any time o Getting new clients gives you options  § Drop clients you are not satisfied with § Raise rates o Tactics such as social media or referral marketing are ongoing and don’t usually produce immediate results

PAGE_2:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 2 Learning Objectives:  ü A wealth of online tactics you can use to get new clients through the internet ü Offline tactics you can use to gain more clients ü How to decide which tactics are best for you ü How to start implementing these tactics and reaping the rewards   Action Steps: 1. Before we get started, sit down and clarify your goals in reading this course. Be as specific as possible, stating things like how many clients you'd like to gain, how you'd like to go about getting clients primarily, and what you'd like to see happen in the future.

PAGE_3:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 3 Module 1 – Online Tactics to Get More Clients  ü The internet offers many ways to gain new clients ü It’s important to employ online and offline tactics  Your Website ü Tell clients what’s unique about your business ü Interest and engage clients ü Use a platform like WordPress to make it easier ü Use the main page to get clients to sign up ü Ask current or former clients for testimonials ü Include your URL everywhere you appear  Blogging ü Try using a platform, adding a blog to your site or writing as a guest blogger ü Write about topics that interest your client ü Put yourself in the shoes of a potential client  Social Media ü Search for terms that clients might use ü Add them as contacts and send an introductory message ü Search for terms a person may use when looking for your service ü Post regular content ü Participate in groups

PAGE_4:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 4 ü Make sure who you are and what you offer is clear ü Be real, honest and don’t try to sell  Email Marketing ü You can send your subscribers informational newsletters ü Make most content non-commercial ü Sometimes make some special offers ü Build a list by asking visitors to provide their name and email  Webinars ü Choose a topic your clients really need ü Teach them how to increase their business ü Make an offer to participants ü Prepare and test your webinar  Podcasts ü Create a podcast about something related to your business ü Figure out what your audience wants then plan the format around that ü Include a call to action with your unique offer ü Put your podcast in iTunes  Advertising ü Place ads using Google Ads, Facebook, Twitter or LinkedIn ü Focus on getting attention quickly by emphasizing benefits ü Test different versions ü Continually monitor and test

PAGE_5:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 5 Online Groups and Forums ü Find where your clients hang out ü Participate in the conversation ü Try to be helpful and don’t try to sell ü Know the rules and observe interactions  Business Listings and Review Sites ü Check to see if your business has a listing ü Create and verify a listing if not ü Make sure your profile clearly explains everything ü Encourage happy clients to leave reviews  Become a Published Author ü Write a book and publish as an eBook or actual print book ü Try giving away eBooks for free ü Address something your potential clients are interested in ü Include a small ad with links to your site ü Encourage people to share the book  Make Videos ü Make and edit a video yourself before sharing it on video sharing sites such as YouTube ü Make instructional videos ü Make videos short and easy-to-digest ü Distribute them everywhere ü Provide help and value

PAGE_6:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 6 Joint Partnerships ü Promote each other ü Find someone whose audience is also your potential audience   Action Steps: 1. Go through each of the tactics listed in this chapter. Ask yourself: Ø Would this be effective for finding potential clients for my business? Ø Is this something I could work into my regular marketing for my business?

PAGE_7:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 7 Module 2 - Offline Tactics to Get More Clients  Events and Meetups ü Find events that are related to your services ü Prepare material to pass out ü Follow Up ü Make yourself visible and prepared at any event ü Create your own events ü Figure out what your clients want  Your Local Chamber of Commerce ü Join your local chamber of commerce or other business groups ü Find other businesses that could benefit from your services ü Benefit from referrals, discounts and access to exclusive events  Public Speaking ü Find events where you can speak or host your own events ü Focus on some task or problem for clients ü Publish engagements on your site  Demonstrations and Educational Events ü Host an open house or outdoor demo

PAGE_8:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 8 Workshops ü You can charge a small fee for attendance ü Have a well-planned curriculum with exercises ü Avoid situations where you’re just lecturing ü Collect contact information and follow up  Referrals ü Do your best work for all clients and exceed expectations ü Put a system in place for referrals  Local Media ü Keep your eye on local media and look for opportunities ü Contact people and let them know what you can do for them ü Offer to link with them through other channels  Action Steps: 1. Which of the above ideas could you potentially use to get more clients? Which are feasible and within your means? Which sound the most interesting to you?

PAGE_9:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 9 Module 3 - How to Decide Which Tactics Are Best for You  Your Skills and Strengths ü Choose tactics that play well to your strengths  Where Are Your Clients? ü Find them and put your offer in front of them ü Create an ideal client profile  Study Your Competitors ü Look at what they are doing ü Find clients that they are missing  Know Your Weaknesses ü Figure out what you’re not so great and avoid it   Action Steps: 1. Take all of the ideas you came up with in the previous Action Steps and consider the ideas presented in this chapter. Which of your ideas now seem best?

PAGE_10:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 10 Conclusion and Next Steps   ü Start off with a handful of tactics ü Gradually add more and monitor everything closely ü Mix everything together for great results  You’ve Learned: ü Tactics for getting new clients online ü Offline tactics for gaining new clients ü How to decide which is best for you ü A few tips on how to maximize your efforts.   Action Steps: 1. Review the course thoroughly and use the action plan in the action guide to record your goals and what needs to happen next.
